basic_info.description: Duplex boasting two spacious units, each with its own unique character. The lower unit features high ceilings, large windows, and an open-concept layout that seamlessly blends the living and dining areas. A modern kitchen with updated appliances adds a touch of contemporary flair, while the private outdoor space invites relaxation.  The upper unit offers similar amenities, with a cozy loft- like feel and picturesque views of the neighborhood. Both units have potential for updates, allowing you to tailor them to your vision.
